scenarios.name: Schema Evolution
scenarios.description: Vendor A changes field names between version 1 and version 2.
scenarios.expected_handling: Normalize both schemas into the canonical Silver schema.

scenarios.name: Schema Heterogeneity
scenarios.description: Vendors use different field names for the same business concepts.
scenarios.expected_handling: Map vendor-specific fields into canonical fields.

scenarios.name: Duplicate Record
scenarios.description: Vendor B sends the same record more than once.
scenarios.expected_handling: Detect and retain the appropriate canonical record.

scenarios.name: Conflicting Values
scenarios.description: Different vendors report different revenue values for the same ticker and business date.
scenarios.expected_handling: Preserve source records in Bronze and apply a deterministic reconciliation rule in Silver.

scenarios.name: Late Arriving Data
scenarios.description: A business event arrives after later events have already been ingested.
scenarios.expected_handling: Use event time and ingestion time independently.

scenarios.name: Record Revision
scenarios.description: A previously reported value is subsequently corrected.
scenarios.expected_handling: Preserve historical knowledge and expose the latest valid version.
